correctness.rationale: The statement uses coefficient ℓ², not function L². B_n and its first n−1 derivatives vanish at the endpoints of the support by continuity and are zero at all exterior knots. At integer arguments the rth derivative taps are the rth backward differences of the value taps of B_{n−r}, by differentiating the box convolution. These give the listed cubic and quartic filters. Exact integer autocorrelations after scaling by 24 on each filter and using common weight denominators 18 and 864 are respectively (10368,0,0) and (497664,0,0,0); dividing by the denominators and by 24² yields the unit impulse. This proves the weighted energy identity by Plancherel on all ℓ², since the taps are finite and convolution is bounded. For uniqueness, norm equality for all inputs forces the continuous symbol to equal 1. Each derivative-order squared symbol has a zero of exactly order r in s=2−2cos θ at s=0 because the difference factor contributes s^r and the lower-degree value taps sum to 1. Hence the constant term and successive coefficients fix all weights, each nonzero and positive. The adjoint with the weighted sample inner product has precisely the finite correlation stencil; it is contractive and has norm one since it inverts the isometry on its range. With only cubic values and first derivatives, the derivative symbol vanishes at θ=0 and π while the value energy ratio is 9; continuity gives the same obstruction to improving the essential frame-bound ratio. A zero value weight cannot give a positive lower bound, and value-only sampling attains the ratio 9. Here 9 is B/A, equivalently the squared condition number of the analysis map, not the square of the frame-operator condition number.

value.rationale: For fixed derivative measurements on the natural cardinal knot grid, exact tightness under scalar channel rescaling is more specific than stable sampling or having some reconstruction. It calibrates coefficient energy without mixing channels and gives a local adjoint rather than a global inverse. Cubic and quartic splines are useful fixed cases; the cubic spectral obstruction explains why the commonly used value and slope channels cannot have comparable performance to the calibrated curvature-inclusive bank even with optimized diagonal weights. Credit that combined calibration and obstruction, not the arithmetic alone or a claim about ambient spline L² energy.
